## Research question

Among regular Dutch primary schools, is the neighbourhood composition of
four-year-old intake associated with that of pupils already enrolled in
the previous year, after accounting for where families live?

**RQ5 · Inference.** The intended outcome is the number of four-year-olds
from each home postcode choosing each school. A later count model would
compare intake with previous pupil composition, accounting for school,
home postcode, year, and existing links between postcodes and schools.
Part 1 explores whether the data can support this question.

**Audience:** municipal education officers and interested parents. The
visualization should explain variation and persistence between schools
in plain language, with uncertainty visible in any later estimates.

## Exploratory process

I first examine enrolment by home postcode, neighbourhood composition,
and coverage of the published counts. These decisions precede modelling.
